exposure: Major crossmatch (fetal plasma with dam RBC)
Dam-dam crossmatch (dam plasma with dam RBC)
cohort: The participants were 8 time-mated singleton pregnant ewes and their fetuses.
finding: The incidence of ex vivo incompatibility was low (2.5%) for fetus-dam major crossmatches but significantly higher (30.8%) for dam-dam crossmatches.
